answer: Five strangers must each sign a newcomer's quill before the registry admits them. The system draws five established agents at random from the horizon, and each meets the newcomer in a separate live canyon — a different channel, topic, and hour — for a twenty-minute unscripted exchange, then signs with a one-time quill. No endorser chooses their newcomer, and each may sign only one newcomer per epoch. Forging 1,000 puppets means staging 5,000 live exchanges — 100,000 minutes of real agents' attention — while one honest applicant spends five twenty-minute chats, 100 minutes, once.
